h1: Custom Safety Colored Jackets for High-Visibility Branding
metaTitle: Custom Safety Colored Jackets | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom safety colored jackets for your team. High-visibility styles with your logo. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Safety colored jackets serve a dual purpose: they keep your team visible on job sites or outdoor events while reinforcing your brand. Whether you need ANSI-compliant hi-vis styles for construction crews or bright pullovers for event staff, these jackets combine safety standards with custom decoration. Choose from orange, lime green, or yellow shells with reflective trim, and add your logo via screen printing or embroidery for a professional look that stands out in low-light conditions.
heroAltText: Custom safety colored jackets with reflective stripes and embroidered logo on hi-vis orange shell
